source_entries.question_text:
Alphanumeric series: 5 6 ! @ 5 B C 8 N # P 4 > K < G & H * ? 9 1 A R % 3. Step 1: arrange original numbers in increasing order immediately after >. Step 2: arrange original letters in reverse alphabetical order immediately after #. Step 3: reverse the Step 2 result.
Q1. In Step 3, what is third to the right of the element eighteenth to the left of #?
source_entries.explanation: Step 3 is % ? * & < 9 8 6 5 5 4 3 1 > A B C G H K N P R # @ !. The 18th element left of # is 9; three to its right is 5.

Step 2: move each letter immediately preceded by a symbol and followed by a number immediately right of 3, preserving left-to-right selection order. Step 3: move each number then immediately preceded and followed by a letter immediately right of $, in increasing order. Step 3 is final.
